decision: Required to start the race from the back of the starting grid.
event_name: Date 29 June 2019 Time 12:55 2019 AUSTRIAN GRAND PRIX 27 - 30 June 2019 The Stewards The Stewards, having received a report from the Technical Delegate (document 17), have considered the following matter and determine the following
fact: A 5th Internal Combustion Engine (ICE), 4th Turbo Charger (TC), 4th Motor Generator Unit-Heat (MGU-H) and 4th Motor Generator Unit-Kinetic (MGU-K) have been used.
offence: Breach of Article 23.3 a) of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
penalty: Required to start the race from the back of the starting grid.
reason: The penalty is imposed in accordance with Articles 23.3 b) of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations. This Penalty does not change the fact that the competitor is required to start from the back of the starting grid for a prior infringement (document 8).
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
